g.text: Composition works — or collapses — by task type

g.text: FIGURE 2 · CAPITALIZATION & SWAP (COMPOSE-BY-STEP) · ACCURACY vs SCALE
composite (red) collapses to ~20% or below and stays flat as the model grows.
capital / swap stay near 90–100% on each simple task alone.
composite in-context recovers — so the ability is there, unused.

g.text: The models have the representational power — what they lack is composing it from simple-task demos alone.
